connector.name: n8n Pro MCP
connector.registryDescription: Manage self-hosted n8n (incl. queue mode): workflows, executions, users, audit - 51 tools.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package n8n-pro-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the helbertparanhos account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.
